title: Buruh halang tugas anggota PGA hingga cedera, pandu melulu dijel 14 bulan
summary: PASIR MAS – Seorang buruh dijatuhi hukuman penjara 14 bulan oleh Mahkamah Majistret di sini hari ini selepas mengaku salah atas pertuduhan menghalang penjawat awam sehingga anggota Pasukan Gerakan Am (PGA) itu cedera ketika menjalankan tugas dan memandu secara melulu pada minggu lalu. title_en: Workers hurt PGA officer, driven to jail for 14 months
summary_en: PASIR MAS – A labourer was sentenced to 14 months in prison by the Magistrate Court here today after pleading guilty on charges of obstructing a civil servant so that he injured a member of General Movement Force (PGA) while carrying out his duties and driving carelessly last week.
